items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: I think he probably worshipped Bechet

ctx.x: Some of them on record, whether or not they have a continuing influence is a matter that's considerably problematic to you. You don't know whether they might or whether they actually do. Let's take some of the people in the first generation, and let's see if you remember specifically that they could have influenced some of the Chicago boys. Was Bechet to any extent imitated?
Not to my knowledge. Of course, the name Mesrose springs to mind immediately, and I think he probably worshipped Bechet. Still does.
Yet I wouldn't say in his playing there's a bravery.
